import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

archive = sys.argv[1]
extracted = pathlib.Path("extracted")
extracted.mkdir()

    names = sorted(
        name for name in zf.namelist()
        if name.endswith(".faa.mafft") and not name.endswith("/")
    )
    for name in names:
        member = pathlib.Path(name).name
        target = extracted / member
        target.write_bytes(zf.read(name))

            ["phykit", "parsimony_informative_sites", str(target)],
            check=True,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
        )
        lines = completed.stdout.strip().splitlines()
        if len(lines) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("unexpected PhyKit output for " + member)
        rows.append(member + "\t" + lines[0])
pathlib.Path("result.tsv").write_text("\n".join(rows) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
